text:
nina: Quick sync — Prospect Helios wants to switch from CompetitorA to Redwood. Main asks: strict parity for client behavior (retries, headers), pricing forecast alignment, and a short security questionnaire answered. POC starts Monday.
sam: got it. key technical constraints: their client auto-retries on 503 and 429 with up-to-3 attempts, and they bill customers for each retry. they want us to either mirror billing or cap it for the POC.
pavan: we should capture per-request retry metadata and surface it in the weekly billing delta report. propose adding `x-rw-retries` header in adapter responses during POC.
claire: buyer wants minimal client changes. can we emulate their headers? their API returns `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-Request-Id`. We currently use `X-RW-Quota-Left` and `X-RW-Id`.
sam: adapter can map headers 1:1. add feature-flag `echo_client_headers=true` for POC to avoid client changes.
claire: perfect. also need to confirm backoff behavior: their client uses jittered exponential backoff (base 200ms, multiplier 2). can we document identical retry timing?
pavan: yes — runtime policy supports configurable retry backoff. i'll add the exact seq in routing doc. example: `200ms, 400ms, 800ms (+ jitter)`.
nina: pricing: can we offer a POC credit that absorbs retry token delta for first 60 days? buyer asked for a predictable cap.
legal: we can do a reimbursed credit up to a cap but need SLA language. suggest: credit up to $X or up to 100K tokens on retry billing, whichever smaller, for 60 days.
claire: buyer also requested logs policy for fallback attempts — they require request bodies not be persisted unless explicitly enabled.
sam: our default retention policy already excludes full payloads for retries; we store event metadata + reason. for debug we can enable sampled payload logging behind a secure toggle and SRP audit.
nina: can you give me one-paragraph text for the questionnaire about payloads and KMS?
legal: drafting now. will include KMS at rest, TLS 1.2+, and separation of PII from logs.
pavan: implementation note: tokenizer differences will change token counts — expect ~3-6% variance vs CompetitorA for the same prompts. include normalization: strip trailing whitespace and canonicalize punctuation before counting to reduce noise.
claire: let's add a small harness hook that reports: `orig_vendor_tokens`, `rw_tokens`, `delta_percent`, `retries` per request. sample line in harness: ```json
{"req_id":"r123","vendor_tokens":412,"rw_tokens":428,"delta_pct":3.88,"retries":1}```
sam: also surface aggregated views per prompt-template and per-user-token so sales can show forecast impact.
infra-bot: POC staging env created: env/poC-helios-staging #8812. Deploy window booked Mon 09:00 UTC.
nina: schedule looks good. can we do a 10% traffic canary first?
sam: yes — console supports token-based splits. propose 5/20/75 ramp over 24h with auto-rollback on error > 1% or latency spike > 2x.
claire: adapter behavior doc needed: map headers, retry semantics, backoff timings, and retry billing policy. i'll draft and PR.
legal: questionnaire draft uploaded to <https://legal.redwood.ai/drafts/helios-poc-qna> — please review before EOD.
pavan: small concern: KV cache TTLs may change tail latency during retries. i'll instrument per-retry latency and kv-cache hit-rate in the harness.
nina: owners: @sam infra & routing, @pavan harness & metrics, @claire adapter doc & header mapping, @legal questionnaire & commercial language. I'll own buyer comms and pricing cap.
claire: one more — their SDK expects a 202 accepted on queued requests; we return 200. We'll add a compatibility response mode in the adapter to return 202 when `Compat-Mode: vendor-a` header is present.
sam: doable. will gate behind feature-flag for the POC.
infra-bot: note: staging maintenance scheduled at 1845695000 UTC — avoid heavy canary ops then.
nina: thanks all. target: demo token-delta dashboard and retry-accounting appendix in next Wed call. any blockers?
pavan: none immediate. will post harness repo link when ready.
claire: adapter PR planned today.
sam: routing doc and flags up later today.
legal: questionnaire answers by tomorrow EOD.
infra-bot: reminder: pipeline/poC-helios-canary #8812 created. :rocket:
